title_en: We are selling a 3+1+2 apartment in Tirana Entry
description_en: The apartment has a total area of ​​116m2, of which 98.3 is the net area of ​​the apartment and 17.7m2 is the common area. The apartment is organized in a living room and three bedrooms, a balcony and two bathrooms. The apartment is located on the seventh floor and is sold together with a parking post at an extra price of €17,000.
